products.title: Apex Pro Negative Cut Glove

Our flagship match glove. A 4 mm contact latex palm, negative-cut fit and a wrap-around wrist lock for a second-skin feel on every catch.

Built for dry and damp conditions, with a finger-saver-free flexible back so nothing gets between you and the ball.

sizeGuide.title: Glove sizing
sizeGuide.howToMeasure: Wrap a tape measure around your dominant hand just below the knuckles, excluding the thumb. Measure from the base of your palm to the tip of the middle finger for length.
sizeGuide.tip: Between sizes? Size up for a roll-finger glove, size down for a negative cut.
